articles.summary: CONSISTENT PERFORMANCE FOR CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE SUCCESS STORYFor almost 60 years, HM Cragg has equipped customers with power solutions that keep the world running. Ranging from Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS) and generators to backup battery applications, HM Cragg solutions keep data centers, core utilities, and other critical infrastructure online through difficult conditions and unexpected disruptions.
articles.title: HM Cragg partners with nVent to drive quality and scalability
